spans.operation: load the full soccer.csv referee-player dataset as the analysis universe
average the two raters' skin-tone ratings into a single continuous skinTone_avg score
collapse the red-card count into a binary any-red-card outcome (redCards>0)
restrict the sample to complete cases with non-missing skin-tone rating and position

search over six candidate skin-tone cutoffs, pick the one that maximizes the unadjusted z-statistic for the red-card-rate difference, and use that cutoff to define/redefine the binary dark/light exposure
z-score standardize the continuous covariates and impute missing standardized values to 0 (the sample mean)
one-hot encode position and league country, dropping the first category as reference group

spans.note: extract outcome column to array y for modeling

spans.operation: specify the primary model as a linear probability model of anyRedCard on dark plus games/position/league covariates, fit by OLS with HC3 robust standard errors

spans.note: pull point estimate, SE, CI, p-value, t-stat for 'dark' out of the fitted OLS object

spans.operation: fit a secondary logistic regression on the same covariate set to obtain an odds-ratio estimate

spans.note: convert log-odds coefficient to odds ratio and derive its CI via normal-approximation transform

spans.operation: refit the adjusted model separately at each candidate threshold to check sensitivity of the risk difference to the cutoff choice
refit the model under five alternative covariate-adjustment sets (minimal, +position, +league, +height/weight, +yellow cards) to check robustness of the dark effect
refit the model treating skin tone as a continuous exposure instead of the dichotomized dark/light variable
compute an unadjusted (no-covariate) risk difference with its own manual z-test/CI directly from dark/light group means
hardcode the point estimates and confidence intervals for four of the six specifications as literal numbers in the plotting code rather than reading them from the result objects fitted earlier

spans.note: write figure to disk

spans.operation: classify the result into SUPPORTED / CONTRADICTORY / INCONCLUSIVE / NOT SUPPORTED using the rule p<0.05 combined with the sign of the CI/point estimate, and print the corresponding narrative
